comment: Cairnwell, a flooded hill-town. The map is the `adjacent` facts in facts.json, partitioned into scopes by the `contains` facts; the rule below is what turns them into a gate. The map is DIRECTED: one `adjacent` fact is one direction, so a two-way road is two facts, and the cairn stair (loc-cairn-stair -> loc-boat-landing) and the roof-plank ladder (loc-drowned-quarter -> loc-highwater-quarter) are single facts because each can only be travelled one way.
